subject: English
chapter: Unit 1: Who Did Patrick’s Homework? / A House, A Home
learningObjectives: Learn the value of hard work and self-help
Understand the difference between a house (structure) and a home (family)
misconceptions: The elf did all the work (Patrick actually did it while helping the elf)

practiceExercises.question: What did Patrick think his cat was playing with?
practiceExercises.explanation: Patrick thought it was a doll, but it was actually a man of the tiniest size (an elf).

flashcards.back: An ignorant person who lacks education
Unselfish acts, brothers, sisters, fathers, mothers

revisionNotes: Self-help is the best help. Patrick changed his attitude towards work.
